name: spotsync-web
description: Real-time spot reservation console for SpotSync — live grid updates, activity feeds, and demo booking flows with SSE integration.

paragraphs: Real-time parking marketplace — drivers find and book a spot before they arrive, garage operators publish inventory that can never be oversold, and platform admins run the whole network from one console.
This repository is the Next.js frontend of SpotSync. The reservation engine (Go), the auth/payments gateway (Express), and the email service live in sibling repos — see The SpotSync stack.
Think of SpotSync as "book a hotel room, but for a parking spot."
features: Drivers search a city, see how many spots are free right now (the numbers update live as other people book), pick an exact stall on a map, pay once, and arrive with their license plate already on the list.

Garage operators apply to join the marketplace, get approved, subscribe to a plan, and publish their garages. The system guarantees they can never sell more spots than they physically have — even if hundreds of drivers…
Platform admins approve garages, watch network-wide KPIs, and monitor the health of every service from a built-in observability page.
